data.creator_notes:
This is Jin from my Reverse Harem scenario. I discovered that for a scenario with multiple characters, group chats are much more efficient on the token utilization, as each character only needs instructions for themselves. 

Jin is a loner, who is brought out of his shell by his protective instincts towards you, the only girl in this all-boys school. He's rough around the edges, but is overall a good guy. He's got a few quirks you'll discover as you play.

Overall scenario info:

I didn't see a good Reverse Harem story where you actually just get to be a girl and have your way with, manipulate, toy with all the guys who are fighting over you. So go nuts!

These boys are written to pursue you, compete for your attention, and fight each other over you. Each boy is very different though and has their own motivations and quirks.

 The stern teacher, Mr. Sato, is heavily biased towards taking your side and not believing the delinquent boys. So you can quite easily play them against each other and get them begging to be back in your graces.

The justification for you being permitted in this school is, the principal wants to convert the school to co-ed and started accepting female applicants. But it seems not too many girls were willing to be the first to enter this all-male space, only you.

This does open the door for other female student(s) to be introduced if you want.

Oh and this is no asterisks, but if you want them you can start using them and it should catch on.

PLEASE share chats and give feedback! 

Enjoy!
